📦 USB CONTENTS:
================================================================================

SanDisk USB (28.6G):
  ✓ Complete Enhancement directory with all application code
  ✓ Docker configuration files (Dockerfile, docker-compose)
  ✓ Automated deployment script (rpi4-setup-complete.sh)
  ✓ Verification tools and documentation
  ✓ All configuration files and dependencies

Lexar USB (231.1G):
  ✓ For execution data/logging on this RPi (keep connected)


🚀 3-STEP DEPLOYMENT:
================================================================================

STEP 1: Insert SanDisk USB into NEW Raspberry Pi 4
────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  a) Insert SanDisk USB into RPi USB port
  b) Boot RPi with Raspberry Pi OS installed
  c) Connect to network (WiFi or Ethernet)


STEP 2: Connect via SSH and Mount USB
─────────────────────────────────────────

  On your laptop/PC:
  $ ssh pi@<new-rpi-ip>

  On the RPi:
  $ lsblk                    # Find USB (usually /dev/sda1)
  $ cd /mnt                  # or any mount location
  $ sudo mount /dev/sda1 /mnt/usb-deployment
  $ cd /mnt/usb-deployment/Enhancement


STEP 3: Run One-Command Deployment
──────────────────────────────────

  $ chmod +x rpi4-setup-complete.sh
  $ ./rpi4-setup-complete.sh

  ⏱️  This takes 10-15 minutes first time
  ✅ Automatically handles everything:
     - System requirements check
     - Docker installation
     - Image building
     - Container startup
     - Health verification


✨ DEPLOYMENT COMPLETE!
================================================================================

Access Dashboard:
  http://<new-rpi-ip>:11078

Check Logs:
  sudo docker logs -f rdk-middleware-dashboard

Container Status:
  sudo docker ps


🔧 OPTIONAL: Copy to Home Directory First
================================================================================

For better performance, copy to home directory instead of running from USB:

  $ cp -r /mnt/usb-deployment/Enhancement ~/Enhancement-deploy
  $ cd ~/Enhancement-deploy
  $ chmod +x rpi4-setup-complete.sh
  $ ./rpi4-setup-complete.sh

(Requires ~20GB free space on RPi)


📚 MORE INFORMATION:
================================================================================

  Full Guide:           USB_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md
  Docker Reference:     DOCKER_QUICK_REFERENCE.txt
  Setup Guide:          DOCKER_SETUP_GUIDE_RPi4.md
  Architecture:         DOCKER_COMPLETE_SETUP.md

  Verify Setup Before Deploying:
  $ chmod +x docker-verify-setup.sh
  $ ./docker-verify-setup.sh


❓ TROUBLESHOOTING:
================================================================================

Issue: "Cannot find USB"
  → $ lsblk                      # Check device name
  → $ sudo mount /dev/sda1 /mnt  # Manually mount if needed

Issue: "Not enough space"
  → Check: $ df -h
  → Use Option C (selective copy) from USB_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md

Issue: "Docker not found"
  → The setup script will auto-install Docker
  → Or manually: curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh

Issue: "Container won't start"
  → Check logs: docker logs -f rdk-middleware-dashboard
  → Run verification: ./docker-verify-setup.sh

Issue: "Slow performance"
  → Copy Enhancement to home directory (see section above)
  → Check disk space: df -h
  → Monitor resources: docker stats


🎯 QUICK REFERENCE:
================================================================================

View logs:
  docker logs -f rdk-middleware-dashboard

Check status:
  docker ps

Monitor resources:
  docker stats rdk-middleware-dashboard

Restart:
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml restart

Stop:
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml stop

SSH into container:
  docker exec -it rdk-middleware-dashboard bash

Update code:
  # Edit files
  docker build -f Dockerfile.rpi.clean -t rdk-middleware-dashboard:rpi4-clean .
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml restart


📞 GETTING HELP:
================================================================================

1. Run verification script:
   $ chmod +x docker-verify-setup.sh
   $ ./docker-verify-setup.sh

2. Check application logs:
   $ docker logs -f rdk-middleware-dashboard | tail -100

3. Review documentation:
   $ cat USB_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md

4. Check Docker status:
   $ docker ps -a
   $ docker inspect rdk-middleware-dashboard


✅ SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS MET:
================================================================================

  ✓ Raspberry Pi 4 (2GB minimum, 4GB+ recommended)
  ✓ 32GB+ storage (64GB+ recommended)
  ✓ Network connectivity (WiFi or Ethernet)
  ✓ Raspberry Pi OS installed
  ✓ SSH enabled


📊 EXPECTED RESULTS:
================================================================================

Docker Image Size:      ~800MB-1GB (optimized)
Build Time (first):     5-10 minutes
Build Time (updates):   2-3 minutes
Memory Usage:           512MB (adjustable)
Startup Time:           30-40 seconds
Dashboard Port:         11078 (configurable)
